code:
Non-breaking:  adding a new optional field (TipAmount)
Non-breaking:  adding a new value to an existing enum
Breaking:      renaming FareAmount -> TotalFare
Breaking:      changing FareAmount from decimal to string
caption: Anything a consumer already relies on changing is breaking, full stop.

eyebrow: Versioning instead of editing in place
code:
schema:
  TotalFare:  { type: decimal, required: true }  # new name
  FareAmount: { type: decimal, deprecated: true } # kept during transition
caption: A new contract version alongside the old, not a silent substitution.
